subject: Hygiene Development
content: Advanced hand hygiene means washing hands correctly at critical times. Critical times: before eating, after toilet, after coughing/sneezing, after touching animals, after touching rubbish, before and after caring for sick person. Proper technique: wet hands, apply soap, scrub all surfaces for 20 seconds, rinse, dry with clean towel. Hand hygiene prevents diarrhoea and respiratory infections.
summary: Wash hands 20 seconds at critical times. Scrub all surfaces. Prevents infections.

quiz_questions.question: How long should you wash hands?

subject: Hygiene Development
content: Menstrual hygiene means managing periods safely. Periods start between ages 9-14. Change pads every 4-6 hours. Wash hands before and after changing. Dispose pads in trash (not toilet). Track periods on calendar.
summary: Change pads every 4-6 hours, wash hands, dispose properly. Periods are normal.

subject: Hygiene Development
content: Food safety prevents foodborne illness. Five keys: Keep clean, separate raw and cooked food, cook thoroughly, keep food at safe temperatures, use safe water. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
summary: Clean, separate, cook, chill, use safe water. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours.
learning_objectives: Learn five keys to food safety
nigerian_examples: Keeping leftover jollof rice in refrigerator

quiz_questions.question: When refrigerate leftovers?
quiz_questions.explanation: Bacteria grow rapidly at room temperature.

subject: Hygiene Development
content: Sanitation systems manage human waste safely. Types: flush toilets, pit latrines, VIP latrines. Never practice open defecation - it spreads diseases like cholera. Always use toilet, flush or cover hole, wash hands after.
summary: Use proper toilets. Open defecation spreads disease. Wash hands after toilet.

subject: Hygiene Development
content: Pandemic prevention stops disease spread. COVID-19 taught us: wash hands, wear masks, maintain distance, stay home when sick, get vaccinated. Cough into elbow, not hands. Follow health guidelines.
summary: Hand hygiene, masks, distancing, vaccination. Cough into elbow. Protect communities.

quiz_questions.question: Where should you cough?
quiz_questions.explanation: Elbow catches droplets without spreading to hands.
